AI Image to Video Adobe skill 1.0.0 – Create videos from still images with cloud AI (no editing experience required):

- Instantly converts uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into animated MP4 video clips with transitions and motion effects.
- Automated cloud workflow: quick setup with anonymous token support, secure session management, and user notification on readiness.
- Simple command routing (e.g. "convert", "export", "credits") and seamless session state handling for batch, edit, and export operations.
- Supports additional formats (mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac) and export up to 1080p by default.
- Error- and event-handling for smooth UX, including self-recovery from token expiry, file issues, or rate limits.
- Ideal for marketers and content creators wanting rapid video creation—no need to use Adobe Premiere or After Effects.
